## Local Memorandum

7 The Parties agree that the dues deduction process described in this Memorandum of Understanding will expire at 11:59 p.m. on May 26, 2012. Provided, however, that if this process proves to be unsatisfactory in any respect or results in unforeseen administrative problems, either party to this agreement may, upon 30 days written notice to the other, terminate this Memorandum of Understanding.
